notes:
Summary: Aurora DevSentry is a regulated fintech (payments + custody) looking for an enterprise code-assistant integrated into developers' IDEs. Primary ask = low-latency streaming completions inside VS Code + JetBrains, deterministic model/version pinning, and strict audit/retention controls for compliance.

Recent call highlights:
- "Wanted: 'copilot that we can trust in production' — CTO quote. Needs model pinning per repo + rollout controls for safe updates.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML + SCIM), per-API-key audit logs, and 7-year retention for certain artifacts (compliance team).
- Deployment: prefer VPC private deployment behind customer-managed peering; fallback to on-prem appliance if cloud not permitted for some teams.
- Encryption: KMS integration with HSM-backed keys required for workspace-level secrets and logs.

Technical constraints & preferences (shorthand):
- Low-latency streaming is critical: 50-100ms token latency target for in-IDE completions under typical dev machine -> backend roundtrip goal.
- Need model/version pinning at route/endpoint level; ability to pin to quantized variants for cost-sensitive teams.
- Session KV cache isolation: security wants per-user and per-repo cache boundaries (no cross-tenant prefix leaks).
- Observability: token-level cost breakouts, 99p latency dashboards, and traceability to commits and user sessions.
- Offline/air-gap option: some biz units require on-prem bundle that can run isolated.

POC plan (submitted): 12-week POC: onboarding 30 engineers, deploy Private control plane into Aurora VPC, configure IDE plugin (VS Code) + model pinning tests, run load scenarios to validate 99th percentile latency and per-token cost reduction with caching. Deliverables: security attestation doc, perf report, and legal-approved SLA.

Quoted concerns / objections:
- "How do you guarantee model snapshot stability?" — head of platform. Need clear versioning and rollback story.
- Pricing sensitivity for 30-seat POC but high upside if SLA metrics met.

Links & artifacts: pricing deck + security Q&A in Drive (sent). Jira tickets open for initial infra questions (INFRA-2219) and sec clarifications (SEC-3371). Gmail thread for contract negotiation (gmail-1928-poc-contract).

Sales notes / ask: Push for architecture deep-dive with Redwood infra team + SecOps next week. Rahul to prepare detailed doc around model pinning + KV cache isolation. Provide sample SLA language and data residency attestation by 2026-03-18.
